profiles.summary: No opcode or control flow difference from the specification was found on any Ethereum build reached on 2026-11-27. New this cycle: geth v1.17.10 built for linux-arm64 with go1.27.3 (rpc.mevblocker.io) and geth v1.16.7 on go1.25.14 (bloXroute) gave the specified word on all 200,127 battery, targeted and cycle 27 edge vectors, and reth's main branch now pins evm2 e80df9c4, whose arithmetic, shift, jump destination and memory code was read and matches what earlier cycles read at 66687c18.

deltas.delta: reth main (version still 2.11.0, unreleased) pins evm2 e80df9c46a8240b056a076ab930b1c5ecf7f1e47 through DaniPopes/evm2. Against 66687c18 (reth v2.11.0), i256.rs, bitwise.rs, control.rs, stack.rs, memory instructions, both jump destination kernels (x86.rs, aarch64.rs) and analysis.rs are byte identical. DIV and MOD now write checked_div or checked_rem with unwrap_or_default, which gives 0 for a zero divisor as before. The cold SSTORE skip threshold moves from ColdStorageAdditionalCost to ColdStorageCost, which changes only whether a frame that is about to run out of gas loads the slot first. Frames returned to the interpreter pool are trimmed before a top-level message, and Interpreter::init still clears memory and return data on reuse, and Vec::resize zero-fills growth.

rpc.mevblocker.io answers Geth/v1.17.10-stable-1df30b18/linux-arm64/go1.27.3 in 665 of 668 bracket reads. This is the first arm64 build of geth's generated interpreter loop that this unit has run. It returned the specified word for all 200,127 vectors (331 of 334 batches bracketed by that build on both sides), and the stored Ethereum reference for all 250 scripts of set 1, all 300 of set 2, the three getFeeGrowthInside borrow scripts and all 23 cycle 28 multi-transaction scenarios.

profiles.summary: Nothing new for gas, the native asset or token contracts on Ethereum. The per-endpoint simulated call gas caps (50 million on publicnode, 550 million on blastapi, 600 million on blockpi, 500 million on MEV Blocker, 50 million to 10 billion behind Pocket) change only how much a simulated call may spend.

No fork is scheduled. eth_config on geth v1.17.9 and reth v2.11.0 reports the Fusaka rules active since 1767747671 (2026-01-07) with no next fork and the same 18 precompiles, the Glamsterdam meta EIP is unchanged since cycle 27 with only Sepolia dated, and ethereum.org states that the mainnet date is not set.

leads.question: When reth tags a release that pins evm2 e80df9c4 or later, do the battery, the targeted set, the cycle 27 edge vectors, script sets 1 and 2 and the 23 cycle 28 scenarios still give the reference words on an endpoint that names that release?
leads.why: reth main already pins a revision that no endpoint runs yet; its arithmetic was read but not run, and Ethereum's reth nodes adopt it on the next release.

leads.question: Is there a public Ethereum endpoint that serves only erigon 3.8.2 and accepts state overrides, so the battery and sequences c and c2 can run on it alone?
leads.why: On Pocket erigon 3.8.2 answered about 2.7 percent of bracket reads in 2,672, so four sends per batch reach it for about one batch in ten.

leadResults.answer: Both parts ran on Ethereum. The three borrow scripts return the reference hash on reth v2.11.0, reth v2.10.0, geth v1.17.9, geth v1.17.10 arm64, geth v1.16.7, reth v2.2.0, dRPC and Pocket (out/borrow-eth.json). The 23 multi-transaction scenarios, run as eth_simulateV1 blocks with state carried between calls, match the reference in every status, return word and final PoolManager slot on reth v2.11.0, reth v2.10.0, geth v1.17.9 and geth v1.17.10 arm64, each request bracketed by one build on both sides, and on 21 of 23 Pocket requests (two refused for gas). Planted one-bit faults were caught (out/simscen-eth.json, out/simscen-planted-*.json).

No way to attribute one Pocket answer to one backend was found. The response headers carry only a request id and rate limit fields. Inside one JSON-RPC batch the elements route separately (a [clientVersion, eth_call, clientVersion] batch came back with v2.10.1 before and v2.11.0 after). eth_simulateV1 blocks have the same fields on reth and geth, and the only per-response variation found is the GAS word, which reflects each operator's gas cap. The two reth builds run evm2 revisions that cycle 27 read as giving the same result for every input, so no in-EVM probe can tell them apart unless one is faulty. The vectors were therefore run by repetition: all 200,127 vectors, four sends per batch, 1,336 sends with 0 mismatches. reth v2.10.1 named itself in 48 percent of 2,672 bracket reads, so each batch reached it at least once with probability about 93 percent if routing is independent. No public endpoint that serves reth v2.10.1 alone was found among 30 tried, so the cycle 24, 26 and 27 'pinned to v2.10.1' results stand only as unpinned results, as the critic restated.

erigon 3.8.2 (go1.27.4 and go1.27.2 builds) named itself in 72 of 2,672 Pocket bracket reads (2.7 percent). The repeated run of 200,127 vectors with four sends per batch and the 23 scenarios found no mismatch from any backend, but this reaches erigon 3.8.2 for only about one batch in ten, and no request is shown to have run on it. No single-build erigon 3.8.2 endpoint was found. Carried as a new low lead.

The crates.io index on 2026-11-27 lists ruint 1.21.1 as the newest release (1.21.0 yanked), and the Unreleased section of the ruint CHANGELOG on main is byte identical to the copy cycle 21 read, so the #701 and #704 fixes are still unreleased and there is nothing new to run.
